findings.finding: Exit ACMRR of GBP34.0m covers about 76% of the only published FY27 revenue estimate (Progressive GBP44.5m), the same coverage FY26 had going in (GBP29.5m ACMRR vs GBP40.0m outturn, 74%), and the SET Exchange Cloud contract goes live in H1 FY27, so a reiterated FY27 outlook is the likely first guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Outlook reiterations have been sold: Oct 2025 finals said 'confident' in FY26 with no number and fell -7.7% (AJ Bell: -9.1% intraday); Mar 2026 interims kept the full year in line and fell -11.6%; Jul 2026 'in line' update fell -6.5%.
findings.original_quote: Beeks exited FY26 with approximately 15% growth in ACMRR in the year, on a constant currency basis, to GBP34.0m (30 June 2025: GBP29.5m) ... providing a strong underpin to FY27 performance.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock has fallen from 225p (15 Sep) to 173p with no RNS, against a one-analyst Buy target of 335p and about 10x trailing EBITDA; if the market were pricing a routine FY27 reiteration the 20-day run-up would not be -20% against the AIM All-Share's c.-4%. Coverage is one house broker plus one paid note, so nobody publishes the ACMRR-to-forecast coverage arithmetic. Capped small because the FY27 bar is a single, pre-July, issuer-sponsored estimate.

findings.finding: Net cash fell from GBP6.96m (Jun 2025) to GBP3.29m (Dec 2025) to GBP0.63m (Jun 2026) on upfront Exchange Cloud and capacity capex, so the audited cash-flow statement in the release will show the full capex and free-cash-flow drain the July update only summarised, the line that sank Luceco on a raised-guide day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not isolated before; the Mar 2026 interims (net cash halved to GBP3.29m, H1 underlying loss) fell -11.6%, and the Jul 2026 update disclosing net cash of GBP0.63m fell -6.5%.
findings.original_quote: Gross cash at year end was GBP5.37m (FY25: gross cash GBP7.36m), with net cash of approximately GBP0.63m (30 June 2025: GBP6.96m). This follows significant upfront infrastructure investment, particularly towards the end of the year, to support the new Exchange Cloud revenue share deployments, several of which are now cash flow positive
findings.why_not_priced: The headline net cash is public, so this is sized small: what is not yet public is the capex total, operating cash conversion and any financing arrangement. On the financing question the money buys revenue-share Exchange Cloud deployments that the company says are already cash-flow positive (Kraken, ASX) and that are corroborated by ACMRR +15%, which is why it is not larger. A placing or facility announced with results would move this either way.

findings.finding: The shares fell from 225p on 15 Sep to 173.22p at the 16 Oct seal (20-day -20.4%) with no RNS between the 1 Sep SET win and the 7 Oct Notice of Results, against an AIM All-Share index that went from 783 to 771 over the same span, and with no disclosed short.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of a comparable unexplained pre-results slide in the baseline history.
findings.why_not_priced: Sized 0 on purpose: an unexplained drawdown is worth nothing until a cause is found, and in a $144k/day AIM name the filing record is not the information set (a fund seller would look identical to informed selling). It is filed because it sets both sides of the reaction: a reiterated outlook against an oversold tape, or confirmation of whatever the sellers know.
